facts.fact: The Decentralisation and Local Development Minister told the National Assembly that a Digital Master Plan for the 394 decentralised local authorities is being updated, under which digital civil registration efforts will be accelerated, BUNEC's capacity strengthened and secondary and special civil registration centres made operational; the update was not yet finished, the address is undated, and the date is the publication date.
